import { CodeGenerator, type ConfigPlugin, withAppBuildGradle } from 'expo/config-plugins';

// Expo Dev Launcher (SDK 56) calls java.time APIs, but the generated template omits
// desugaring while declaring minSdk 24 — without this, startup hard-crashes below API 26.
const DESUGAR_CONFIG = `android {
    compileOptions {
        coreLibraryDesugaringEnabled true
    }
}

dependencies {
    coreLibraryDesugaring("com.android.tools:desugar_jdk_libs:2.1.5")
}`;

export function addAndroidCoreLibraryDesugaring(contents: string): string {
  return CodeGenerator.mergeContents({
    src: contents,
    newSrc: DESUGAR_CONFIG,
    tag: 'rn-dev-agent-core-library-desugaring',
    anchor: /^dependencies\s*\{$/,
    offset: 0,
    comment: '//',
  }).contents;
}

const withAndroidCoreLibraryDesugaring: ConfigPlugin = (config) =>
  withAppBuildGradle(config, (gradleConfig) => {
    if (gradleConfig.modResults.language !== 'groovy') {
      throw new Error('Core library desugaring requires an Android Groovy build.gradle');
    }

    gradleConfig.modResults.contents = addAndroidCoreLibraryDesugaring(
      gradleConfig.modResults.contents,
    );
    return gradleConfig;
  });

export default withAndroidCoreLibraryDesugaring;
